scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres s3 && docker compose run --rm s3-init
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.alerts:check: docker run --rm --entrypoint sh -v "$PWD/infra/observability:/w:ro" -w /w prom/prometheus:v3.15.0 -c 'promtool check rules alerts.yml && promtool test rules alerts.test.yml'
